name: Screening Mammography — Bilateral
description: Screening mammography template. Focuses on breast density, masses, calcifications, asymmetries, distortion, and BI-RADS assessment/recommendation.

fields.name: exam
fields.label: Exam
fields.description: Exam type and technique (e.g., 2D + DBT) if provided.

fields.name: clinical_history
fields.label: Clinical History
fields.description: Screening vs diagnostic; symptoms if mentioned.

fields.name: comparison
fields.label: Comparison
fields.description: Prior mammograms and dates if available.

fields.name: findings_density
fields.label: Findings — Breast Density
fields.description: ACR density category if stated; otherwise describe qualitatively from input.

fields.name: findings
fields.label: Findings
fields.description: Masses, calcifications, asymmetries, distortion, and any pertinent negatives.

fields.name: impression
fields.label: Impression
fields.description: BI-RADS assessment and recommendation if supported by input; otherwise concise summary.
